title: Data
noDatabasesHint: Connect PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB or Redis.
structureNote: Structure (tables, fields, links) is part of the app and ships with releases as migrations.
recordsNote: Records belong to each environment. Copying or releasing the app never copies them.

conn.credentialsHint: Write-only. Values are stored in the vault and never shown again.
conn.detachBody: Removes this database and its {count} {kind} from the app structure. The database and its records stay on the server.
conn.replaceDesc: Paste a password or full connection URI. It is stored as {ref} and can’t be read back.

table.deleteBody: Removes the table from the app structure. The next release drops it in each environment, with its records.

gen.title: Generate test data
gen.note: Fills {n} fields with realistic values and links to existing {targets}.
gen.devOnly: Added to Development only and marked as test. Releases never copy them.

records.emptyHint: Use Generate test data to fill this table for testing.
records.deleteBody: It is removed from Development. Other environments are not affected.
records.fileHint: Files are uploaded from the app

fields.name: Field name
fields.addNote: Adds to the app structure. Existing {n} records get an empty value — nothing is deleted.
fields.keyHint: Stable id used by pages and logic. It doesn’t change when you rename the field.

rels.outEmpty: This table doesn’t point to other tables.
rels.inEmpty: No other table points to this table’s primary key.

ddl.note: Generated from the app definition. Change fields in the Fields tab and this updates. Edits made directly in the database aren’t tracked.

diagram.hint: Drag tables by their header · double-click to open
diagram.empty: No tables in this database yet

sql.devOnly: The console runs on Development by default. Other environments need admin approval.
sql.noSql: {engine} has no SQL. Queries here run on the app’s table view of this data.
sql.empty: Run a query to see results

newDb.title: Create a database
newDb.desc: Pick an engine, name it and tell Platon how to reach it.
newDb.name: Name
newDb.env: Credentials for Development. Add Staging and Production on the database page.

newTable.title: New {unit}
newTable.desc: Creates the structure only. Each environment starts with 0 records — nothing is copied from Development.
newTable.name: Name
newTable.fieldsHint: A numbered # field is added automatically.
